module: Console VM script: runs bananabench on a fixed list of 9 vehicles (barstow, burnside, etki, fullsize, moonhawk, pessima, pickup, pigeon, pressure_ball) and writes an XML "performance" report (report > test > result with success, performance, executiontime, compiletime and realtime/maxmbeams metrics) to bananabench.xml. It also defines a small global `XML` class (create, addChild, encode, toString) to generate XML.
notes: Probably broken with the current version of bananabench: `writeXML` reads `v.tests[1].res[dynamicCol]` and the `beamspersec` fields, whereas bananabench.lua returns flat `res` {Mbeamspersec, percentRealtime, time, spawntime} (without index 1/2 or a beamspersec field); accessing res[dynamicCol] gives nil and causes an error.
The script runs on load; the `XML` class is a global. The `str` variables of XML:encode and XML:toString are also global (no `local`).
The report's `measure` and `unit` attributes follow the format of an external performance reporting tool; the executed field is always 'yes' and passed 'yes' (log analysis is commented out).

create.desc: Creates an empty XML node (name, attribs, children).

encode.desc: Returns the complete document with the header `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>`.

toString.desc: Serializes the node and its children with 2-space indentation.
